work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letters CCVII (numeral OCR CCV;) extend to the kingdom of Sicily on this side of the Faro Pius VI’s transfer of the feast of s. Francis of Paola to the second Sunday after Easter; LF44121 → LF44127 across page number 301 LF44124; LF44189 → LF44198 across own provenance LF44192 and page number 302 LF44195; complete 10 May 1839 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF44115–44115; the source closing at LF44205–44208 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima maii millesimo octingen- tesimo trigesimo nono, pontificatus Nostri anno nono, Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
